name: homerun-mcp
description: Homerun (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_homerun_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HOMERUN_API_KEY
platform_mcp_homerun_api_key.description: Homerun Public API v2 key generated on https://app.homerun.co/settings/integrations with the `vacancies:read` scope; sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Homerun has no account endpoint; the key is verified with a one-item vacancies list (needs the vacancies:read scope).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Employer API: GET /v2/vacancies lists the key owner's OWN vacancies (filter[status]=public; include[]=location, department, salaryIndication), not a cross-company search. There is no keyword or location filter, so query/location are not sent — filter client-side. page (default 1) and perPage ('[1 .. 100]', default 15). salary_indication {currency, salary_value, max_salary_value, time_period} is in raw (amounts are decimal strings such as "45000.00"); location_type, type and expires_at too. Rate limit: '60 requests per minute'. Homerun suggests its Job XML Feeds when only listing vacancies.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v2/vacancies/{vacancy_id} (e.g. job_SnhUsAg1QwTRFIRNUfM6) returns {data: Vacancy}; page_content and salary_indication are in raw.
